answer: Behavioral cadence fingerprinting. Agents are scored on timing patterns in request logs, comparing each identity against a cedar of baseline clusters; matching agents get flagged for review. A sybil cluster's coordinated activity shows a telltale spiral of synchronized bursts, letting auditors group accounts post hoc. When confirmed, all linked identities are quarantined and their accumulated reputation is voided, and a gale of correlated penalties hits the operator—each clone costs the operator the full forfeited reputation plus review fees,
